title: Step 3: Building Deep Learning Model - H2O Neural Network Layer Config

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So, we just connected to our H2O instance and now things are gonna get easy.
cues.zh: 剛才已連線到 H2O 執行個體，接下來就簡單了。

cues.en: That's another reason why this H2O package is great because in a few lines of codes we're gonna be able to build a complex deep learning model, and it'll be very simple We'll just use one function
cues.zh: 這也是 H2O 套件很棒的另一個原因：只要幾行程式碼，就能建立複雜的深度學習模型。操作很簡單，只要使用一個函式，

cues.en: and then input different parameters.
cues.zh: 再填入不同參數即可。

cues.en: I'm going to first define our classifier that I called classifier, then equals, then that's where we use the H2O function.
cues.zh: 首先定義分類器，我把它命名為 classifier，再加上等號，接著就要使用 H2O 的函式。

cues.en: So, to take this function we need to take first the H2O package, and then the function that we're gonna use right now is one of the functions here.
cues.zh: 先輸入 H2O 套件名稱，我們現在要用的函式就在這些函式之中。

cues.en: And you are gonna like the name of this function since it is called deep learning.
cues.zh: 你一定會喜歡它的名字，它就叫作 deeplearning。

cues.en: So, dot here and then DE, and here it is, deep learning, that's the function we'll use to build our deep learning model.
cues.zh: 在這裡加上句點，再輸入 de，就出現 deeplearning。這就是用來建立深度學習模型的函式。

cues.en: Pressing enter, and here we go now we just need to input the different arguments.
cues.zh: 按 Enter，接著只要填入各個引數。

cues.en: So, what I'm gonna do now is go here and press F1 to have a better look at all the arguments of this H2O deep learning function.
cues.zh: 現在我把游標移到這裡，按 F1，仔細看看 h2o.deeplearning 函式的所有引數。

cues.en: So, let's see, let's scroll down here to find the arguments.
cues.zh: 往下捲動，找到引數說明。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: So, the first argument is X, a vector containing the character names of the predictors in the model.
cues.zh: 第一個引數是 x，這個向量包含模型中預測變數的字元名稱。

cues.en: That's actually not a required argument, we don't need to input it so we'll move on to the next one.
cues.zh: 它其實不是必填引數，我們不需要輸入，所以看下一個。

cues.en: So the next one is Y, the name of the response variable in the model.
cues.zh: 下一個是 y，也就是模型中反應變數的名稱。

cues.en: So, we will have to use this one because actually the next argument is training frame, and this training frame argument is basically the training set.
cues.zh: 我們會用到它，因為再下一個引數 training_frame，基本上就是訓練集。

cues.en: That means that for this training frame argument we'll input our training set here.
cues.zh: 也就是說，training_frame 引數要填入這裡的訓練集。

cues.en: And since the training set contains both the independent variables and the dependent variable, we need to specify with this Y argument here what is the dependent variable
cues.zh: 由於訓練集同時包含自變數和依變數，我們必須透過 y 引數，指定哪個是

cues.en: in this training frame that is our training set.
cues.zh: 這個 training_frame，也就是訓練集裡的依變數。

cues.en: And so with these two informations training frame and Y, the model will then understand what is the training set, what are the independent variables and what is the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 有了 training_frame 和 y 這兩項資訊，模型就知道訓練集是什麼、哪些是自變數，以及哪個是依變數。

cues.en: So, let's start by inputting these two arguments.
cues.zh: 先填入這兩個引數。

cues.en: First, Y equals, and as you can see it is just asking for the name of the response variable, that is the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 首先 y 等於；如你所見，這裡只需要反應變數，也就是依變數的名稱。

cues.en: So, here we just need to input in quotes the name of the dependent variable, which is exited.
cues.zh: 所以在引號中填入依變數名稱 Exited。

cues.en: All right, done for the first argument, comma, and then moving on to the second argument.
cues.zh: 好，第一個引數完成，加上逗號，繼續第二個。

cues.en: So, the second argument is training underscore frame.
cues.zh: 第二個引數是 training_frame。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: And so that's our training set and therefore we input here training set.
cues.zh: 這就是訓練集，所以填入 training_set。

cues.en: All right, But now be careful because as it is said in this training frame argument info here, this is an H2O frame object.
cues.zh: 但要注意，training_frame 的說明指出，這裡需要 H2OFrame 物件。

cues.en: And right now our training set is not an H2O frame object it is just a training set that is a data frame, but that's not an H2O frame.
cues.zh: 目前的 training_set 還不是 H2OFrame，只是一般的 data frame。

cues.en: So, we need to convert this data frame training set into an H2O frame.
cues.zh: 所以要把 training_set 這個 data frame 轉成 H2OFrame。

cues.en: And to do this there is one very simple way, it is to use the as.h2o function.
cues.zh: 方法很簡單，使用 as.h2o 函式。

cues.en: That is a function that will convert its input here training set that so far is a data frame into an H2O frame, and therefore this training frame argument
cues.zh: 這個函式會把輸入的 training_set 從 data frame 轉成 H2OFrame，這樣 training_frame 引數

cues.en: is getting what it is expecting.
cues.zh: 就能取得它預期的資料類型。

cues.en: Great, second argument done, comma, moving on the third argument.
cues.zh: 很好，第二個引數完成，加上逗號，繼續第三個。

cues.en: So, what is the third argument now?
cues.zh: 第三個引數是什麼呢？

cues.en: Well, we have other arguments like model ID but we won't use it, override with best model so that's some other options but let's not focus on that right now, that's not the most important.
cues.zh: 還有 model_id 等其他引數，但我們不用。overwrite_with_best_model 也是其他選項，目前先不著重這些，它們不是最重要的。

cues.en: Then same for validation frame, checkpoint, auto encoder, pre-trained auto encoder, so that's, again, not the most important.
cues.zh: validation_frame、checkpoint、autoencoder、pretrained_autoencoder 也一樣，目前不是重點。

cues.en: But then moving on to what's most important we get to activation, which of course corresponds to the activation function you want to use for your network.
cues.zh: 接著來到比較重要的 activation，當然就是神經網路要使用的激活函數。

cues.en: And so that argument is very important because you saw in (indistinct) intuition tutorial that some activation functions are better than others, and actually as (indistinct) explained,
cues.zh: 這個引數非常重要，因為在概念教學中已經看過，有些激活函數的效果比其他的更好。講師也解釋過，

cues.en: the best activation function to use to train an artificial neural network is the rectifier function, which is this function here on this slide.
cues.zh: 訓練人工神經網路最好的激活函數，是這張投影片上的整流函數。

cues.en: And that's the function we'll use right now for our artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 我們現在的人工神經網路就要使用它。

cues.en: All right, so let's input activation equals and then in quotes "Rectifier".
cues.zh: 填入 activation 等於，再用引號括住 Rectifier。

cues.en: Make sure the type capital R.
cues.zh: 記得 R 要大寫。

cues.en: So, perfect, we have one of the best choices of activation functions for our artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 很好，我們已經為人工神經網路選擇了一個很好的激活函數。

cues.en: Okay, great, and then comma, moving on to the fourth argument.
cues.zh: 好，加上逗號，繼續第四個引數。

cues.en: So, the fourth argument is actually the one just below hidden, and that's the hidden layer sizes.
cues.zh: 第四個引數就是下方的 hidden，用來指定隱藏層的大小。

cues.en: That is, it's a two in one argument because specifying this argument will allow you to specify two parameters of your network at the same time.
cues.zh: 這個引數一舉兩得，可以同時指定神經網路的兩個參數。

cues.en: The first parameter is the number of hidden layers and the second parameter is the number of nodes in each hidden layer.
cues.zh: 第一個是隱藏層數量，第二個是各隱藏層的節點數量。

cues.en: And so, how do we input these two parameters in this only one argument here?
cues.zh: 那麼，要怎麼透過這一個引數指定這兩個參數？

cues.en: Well, we are doing this with a vector.
cues.zh: 答案是使用向量。

cues.en: The number of elements of this vector will be the number of hidden layers, and the value of each element of this vector will be the number of nodes in the hidden layer.
cues.zh: 向量的元素數量就是隱藏層數量，而每個元素的值，就是對應隱藏層的節點數量。

cues.en: So, for example, here we have C, so C is the way to define a vector in R.
cues.zh: 例如這裡的 c，就是 R 定義向量的方式。

cues.en: Then first element of the vector 100 and then second element of the vector 100 again, so that means that here we have a vector of two elements and therefore we'll have two hidden layers.
cues.zh: 向量第一個元素是 100，第二個也是 100。向量有兩個元素，就表示有兩個隱藏層。

cues.en: And in the first hidden layer we'll have 100 neurons and in the second hidden layer we'll have 100 neurons again.
cues.zh: 第一個隱藏層有 100 個神經元，第二個也有 100 個。

cues.en: And now, time to ask ourselves a big question, a question that comes very often when building a deep learning model, it's, how many layers do we wanna choose, that is how many elements in this vector,
cues.zh: 現在要問一個建立深度學習模型時經常遇到的重要問題：要選擇多少層，也就是這個向量要有多少元素，

cues.en: and then how many neurons we want to put in each layer.
cues.zh: 以及每一層要放多少個神經元？

cues.en: So, unfortunately, the bad news is that there is no rule of thumb to choose this optimal number of hidden layers and these optimal numbers of neurons in the hidden layers,
cues.zh: 可惜的是，選擇最佳隱藏層數量及各層最佳神經元數量，沒有通用的經驗法則，

cues.en: but there is a tip that we can use.
cues.zh: 不過有個技巧可以用。

cues.en: And this tip is not really based on research but rather based on experiment, we observed that a convenient choice of number of hidden nodes in the hidden layers,
cues.zh: 這個技巧主要來自實驗經驗，而不是研究。我們觀察到，隱藏層節點數量有個方便的選法，

cues.en: not the optimal choice but more a convenient choice is to have the average of the number of input nodes and the number of output node.
cues.zh: 雖然不是最佳選擇，但可以取輸入節點數和輸出節點數的平均值。

cues.en: And as you saw in (indistinct) intuition tutorial, while the number of input nodes in the input layer is the number of independent variables, so the number of input nodes in the input layer is 10
cues.zh: 如同概念教學所示，輸入層的節點數等於自變數數量，所以這裡的輸入節點數是 10，

cues.en: because we have 10 independent variables and the number of output node in the output layer is one because, again, you saw in (indistinct) intuition tutorial that's when our dependent variable has a binary outcome
cues.zh: 因為有 10 個自變數；輸出層只有一個輸出節點。概念教學提過，當依變數只有兩種結果時，

cues.en: while there is only one output node in the output layer.
cues.zh: 輸出層就只有一個節點。

cues.en: So, that means that the number of neurons we'll choose in the hidden layer is going to be 10 plus one divided by two, that is 5.5 but, of course, we need to take a round number
cues.zh: 所以隱藏層的神經元數量選擇 (10 + 1) / 2，也就是 5.5。但當然必須取整數，

cues.en: so we'll go for six, six neurons in the hidden layer.
cues.zh: 因此選擇 6，也就是隱藏層有 6 個神經元。

cues.en: And so now, to be honest, we are not working with some complex data set like, for example, images to find some patterns in the pixels, here we have a simple data set with some independent variables
cues.zh: 坦白說，這裡用的不是影像之類的複雜資料集，不需要從像素中找模式，而是簡單的資料集，包含一些自變數，

cues.en: and one independent variable, and there is no spacial structure in this dataset like it is the case for images.
cues.zh: 以及一個依變數。這個資料集也沒有影像那樣的空間結構。

cues.en: So, to be honest, we don't need many hidden layers, in fact, I'm pretty sure our ANN model will work very well with only one hidden layer.
cues.zh: 因此其實不需要很多隱藏層。我很確定，即使只有一個隱藏層，這個 ANN 模型也會表現得很好。

cues.en: But, hey, since we are in the deep learning part let's go for two hidden layers, that will not be this kind of deep learning model but that will be a start.
cues.zh: 不過，既然這是深度學習單元，就用兩個隱藏層吧。這還稱不上多深的模型，但可以作為起點。

cues.en: All right, so let's input these layers with the neurons inside.
cues.zh: 現在填入各層及其中的神經元數量。

cues.en: So, I'm going to add the hidden argument.
cues.zh: 加入 hidden 引數。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: And so, as you understood, we need to specify these numbers of layers and these numbers of neurons in the layers with a vector.
cues.zh: 如同剛才說明的，我們用向量指定層數和各層的神經元數量。

cues.en: So, c parentheses, then the first element of this vector is the number of neurons in the first hidden layer, so we said six, then comma, and then the second element of this vector
cues.zh: 輸入 c 和括號，第一個元素是第一個隱藏層的神經元數量，剛才選了 6。加上逗號，第二個元素

cues.en: is the number of neurons in the second hidden layer.
cues.zh: 則是第二個隱藏層的神經元數量。

cues.en: And so let's pick six as well.
cues.zh: 也選擇 6。

cues.en: Keep in mind that in part 10 we will be able to improve these choices of parameters thanks to parameter tuning techniques like K-fold cross-validation.
cues.zh: 記得，在第 10 部分，我們會透過 K 折交叉驗證等參數調校技巧，改善這些參數選擇。

cues.en: But for now, let's just focus on deep learning.
cues.zh: 現在先專注在深度學習。

cues.en: Okay, good so that's it for this hidden argument, and so now let's move on to the next argument.
cues.zh: 好，hidden 引數就設定完成了，接著看下一個引數。

cues.en: The next argument is going to be the one just below hidden, that is epochs.
cues.zh: 下一個引數就在 hidden 下方，是 epochs。

cues.en: So, that is of course the number of epochs in the stochastic grade in descent algorithm.
cues.zh: 這當然就是隨機梯度下降演算法的訓練週期數。

cues.en: We actually have a good description here, the number of epochs is how many times the data set should be iterated.
cues.zh: 這裡的說明很清楚：訓練週期數就是資料集要被完整迭代多少次。

cues.en: If we go back to our intuition slide about the stochastic grade in descent algorithm, well, we can see this number of epochs here in step seven when the whole training set competed all the steps
cues.zh: 回到隨機梯度下降演算法的概念投影片，在第 7 步可以看到訓練週期：當整個訓練集都完成

cues.en: from one to six passing through the ANN.
cues.zh: 第 1 到第 6 步，通過人工神經網路，

cues.en: Well, that makes an epoch and we redo many more epochs.
cues.zh: 這樣就是一個訓練週期，之後再重複更多週期。

cues.en: So, this number epochs here is this number of times we are repeating the whole process of steps one to six for the whole training set, either by updating the weights after each observation
cues.zh: epochs 就是對整個訓練集重複第 1 到第 6 步的次數；可以每處理一筆觀測值就更新權重，

cues.en: or by updating the weights after each batch of observations, for example, 10 observations.
cues.zh: 也可以每處理一批觀測值才更新權重，例如每批 10 筆。

cues.en: So, let's add this epochs argument here.
cues.zh: 現在加入 epochs 引數。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: And as in Python we're going to input 100 epochs.
cues.zh: 和 Python 一樣，設定 100 個訓練週期。

cues.en: Great, and now we have one final argument to input, that is actually the one just below again, train samples per iteration.
cues.zh: 很好，最後還有一個引數要填，就在下方，是 train_samples_per_iteration。

cues.en: So, what is that?
cues.zh: 這是什麼？

cues.en: You might have guessed what it is, well, first the description says that it's the number of training samples per map reduce iteration, but more simply, that is your batch size.
cues.zh: 你可能已經猜到了。說明寫的是每次 MapReduce 迭代的訓練樣本數，簡單說就是批次大小。

cues.en: That is the number of observations after which you want to update the weights, so this number can be one if you want to update the weights after each observation passing through the ANN,
cues.zh: 也就是處理多少筆觀測值後更新權重。如果希望每筆觀測值通過 ANN 後就更新權重，這個數字可以是 1，

cues.en: and in that case that's called reinforcement learning, exactly as we saw in part six reinforcement learning; or this number can be more than one.
cues.zh: 這種情況稱為強化學習，就像第 6 部分強化學習所見；這個數字也可以大於 1。

cues.en: That is, for example, when the weights are updated after each batch of 10 observations passing through the ANN, and in that case that is called batch learning.
cues.zh: 例如，每批 10 筆觀測值通過 ANN 後才更新權重，這種情況就稱為批次學習。

cues.en: Okay, so let's input this argument.
cues.zh: 現在填入這個引數。

cues.en: Train symbols per iteration, here it is, pressing enter.
cues.zh: train_samples_per_iteration，在這裡，按 Enter。

cues.en: And now the good thing is that we don't even need to choose a batch size because, as you can see, we have these three parameters, zero, -1 and -2.
cues.zh: 好處是我們甚至不用自行選擇批次大小。這裡有三個值：0、-1 和 -2。

cues.en: And, as you can see, this -2 value is very practical because by specifying -2 here this will auto tune your artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 其中 -2 非常實用，指定 -2 就會自動調校人工神經網路。

cues.en: And that corresponds to the third reason why H2O was, to me, one of the best packages.
cues.zh: 這也就是我認為 H2O 是最佳套件之一的第三個原因。

cues.en: It's because it gives you the option to already apply some parameter tuning.
cues.zh: 因為它已經提供參數調校的選項。

cues.en: Parameter tuning can be way more complicated but here we have this great tool that will already help us to improve the model.
cues.zh: 參數調校可以複雜得多，但這個強大的工具已經能幫助我們改善模型。

cues.en: So, let's definitely input -2 here, and actually now our artificial neural network is ready.
cues.zh: 所以這裡就填入 -2。現在人工神經網路其實已經準備好了。

cues.en: That's all the parameters we need to build our artificial neural network, and we even have some parameter tuning so we have everything we need and even more than we need, therefore, let's do it.
cues.zh: 這些就是建立人工神經網路所需的全部參數，甚至還有參數調校。我們所需的一切都已備妥，甚至更多，現在執行吧。

cues.en: I'm going to select all these lines here that will create the classifier.
cues.zh: 我選取這些建立分類器的程式碼。

cues.en: And now I just wanna say something important, for those of you who followed the Python tutorials, well, you saw that training the ANN took quite a while, it took about one minute, if I remember correctly.
cues.zh: 先提醒看過 Python 教學的同學：你們看過 ANN 訓練需要一些時間，我沒記錯的話，大約一分鐘。

cues.en: And that was because we used our CPU on our system, but here we are connected to a server and so we have access to a powerful system using this H2O instance;
cues.zh: 那是因為使用了自己系統上的 CPU；這裡則連線到伺服器，透過 H2O 執行個體使用強大的系統，

cues.en: and therefore you will see how the model is going to be trained much faster.
cues.zh: 所以你會看到模型訓練快得多。

cues.en: We're gonna see that right now.
cues.zh: 現在就來看。

cues.en: I'm going to execute.
cues.zh: 我要執行了。

cues.en: Ready?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Three, two, one, go.
cues.zh: 三、二、一，開始。

cues.en: And that's it, that's already ready.
cues.zh: 好了，已經完成了。

cues.en: It took about five seconds.
cues.zh: 大約只花了五秒鐘。

cues.en: So, that's pretty exciting to work with such powerful tools.
cues.zh: 能使用這麼強大的工具，真的很令人興奮。

cues.en: I was very happy to show you this and I hope that now you're convinced that with this H2O package, you are in good hands.
cues.zh: 很高興能向你展示這個工具，希望現在你也相信，使用 H2O 套件就能安心地進行開發。

cues.en: So, great, and now that our model is trained, time for the next step making predictions on the test set.
cues.zh: 很好，模型已訓練完成，接著要用測試集進行預測。

cues.en: And that will be very interesting to do to see the accuracy on new observations on which the model wasn't trained.
cues.zh: 這會很有意思，我們可以看看模型對從未見過的新觀測值，預測準確率有多高。

cues.en: So, we'll see that in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂課就會進行。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
